fullContentHtml:
RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Exam City Details for the post of 2nd Grade Teacher (Senior Teacher)/ Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT). This recruitment has been issued for 6500 posts. Online applying process for Rajasthan RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Recruitment 205 were accepted from 19 August 2025 to 17 September 2025. The Examination is going to conducted on 12-18 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Rajasthan RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Exam City Details 2026. which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 July 2025
  • Application Start Date : 19 August 2025
  • Last Date : 17 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 12-18 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 05 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Exam City Details 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 17 September 2025.

The official website is: https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in/news

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
